title: The verdict format, version 1
description: A run's verdict on the work of its round: the file of a version of the artifact type verdict, which qory run verdict stores. passed: the work meets the bar. changes-requested: the work needs another round. escalate: a person must act, and points lists what is wrong or missing and what the person can do. changes-requested may have points too, each a run_again point: what is wrong or missing, for the next round. A verdict of any kind may have a track: the track the run proposes for the work item, where the gate of the run's stage offers tracks. A track the gate does not offer is rejected with 422. The question of an answer point is open in the work item's newest questions version, which a JSON Schema cannot check. No object has a member this schema does not define.

points.description: What is wrong or missing, 1 to 20 points: required when verdict is escalate, optional when verdict is changes-requested, where each point has action run_again, and absent when verdict is passed.

track.description: The track the run proposes, with the reason in one sentence on one line. id is the id of a track that the gate of the run's stage offers: one lower-case word, or lower-case words joined by hyphens, such as small-change, at most 40 characters. A verdict with no track proposes none.

reason.description: Why the run proposes this track, 1 to 300 characters.

point.description: One point: what is wrong or missing and its action. question is required when action is answer, and absent when action is run_again. fix is optional when action is run_again, and absent when action is answer. An answer point comes only with escalate.

text.description: What is wrong or missing, in one plain sentence on one line, 1 to 500 characters, with no action and no question id: Qory Apiary adds the action from action.

action.description: answer: a person answers the question in question, only with escalate. run_again: another round runs; with escalate, a person runs it.

question.description: The id of an open question in the work item's newest questions version, in the id form of questions.schema.json: 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as q1.

fix.description: What a person does to fix it, in one plain sentence on one line, 1 to 500 characters: Qory Apiary shows it in place of the sentence of the action run_again.

line.description: Text on one line: it has no control character, so none of U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F, and no tab, line feed or carriage return. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB. This is the line of questions.schema.json.
